benefit.source: USDA FNS FY2024 national average per household

household_size_eligible.note: Persons per eligible household. Drives the headline dollar range: fewer persons/household => more households => higher $. Range is an assumption band, NOT a statistical confidence interval — never label it as CI.

mock_report_policy: submitted-basis; render LOW and MID scenarios only; the HIGH scenario must never appear in any generated artifact
